paths.description: Homepage and latest-video listing; global navigation, preferences, responsive layout and content hierarchy.
Hentai category as representative category/listing template; pagination and filter density.
Representative video detail and Play interaction; player, ads, metadata, memory and core watch journey.
Search for latina as representative query/results flow.
Site-wide headers, cookies, third parties, secrets, robots/sitemap and a real 404 recovery state.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark-theme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-equivalent in palette to the normal light UI, and the probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: Full-page navigation swaps are abrupt.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition CSS and the MPA listing-to-detail route uses an unenhanced full document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing, search, category and detail navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no position-aware navigation chrome.
findings.evidence: The full-page mobile capture is 2324 CSS px tall, while the probe found no scroll-state/container-query signal, progress indicator or reacting header.
findings.suggestedFix: Use lightweight scroll-aware chrome or an appropriate progress/back-to-top affordance without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Dense tag chrome and advertising compete with the primary content.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show two navigation rows, a full-width legal banner, 25+ tag pills and a large ad block around the video/listing before supporting content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repetitive tag chrome, group secondary filters in a disclosure, and reserve ad placements that do not dominate the primary task.

findings.summary: Mobile browsers receive a scaled 980 px desktop page instead of a mobile layout.
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 viewport, layout reports hasViewportMeta=false and a 980 px layout viewport at scale 0.367; the full-page screenshot shows tiny four-column cards and text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standard responsive viewport meta tag and rebuild the grid/navigation with intrinsic fluid sizing and readable mobile breakpoints.

findings.summary: Repeated card and player components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: The mobile captures preserve the desktop four-column grid and wide player; the probe found no @container/container-type CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Make cards/player container-aware and collapse the listing to an appropriate column count at narrow inline sizes.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are too small.
findings.evidence: The focused first link computed to outline-style none and no box-shadow; the probe listed many links only 14–22 px high, corroborated by Lighthouse target-size failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and enlarge/space touch targets to at least an accessible practical size.

findings.summary: The representative watch flow does not progress after activating Play.
findings.evidence: Clicking .vjs-big-play-button produced an identical before/after screenshot (matching SHA-256) and the 5-second interaction video shows no actionable verification or playback state; required age-verification steps are not explained next to the control.
findings.suggestedFix: Make Play reveal a clear, keyboard-accessible age-verification step or start playback; expose failure/loading messaging and a retry path.

findings.summary: Mobile lab LCP is outside the good threshold on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.0 s and FCP 2.4 s on the homepage, while the trace measured LCP 2.01 s under a separate desktop-like run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the real LCP resource and reduce document/third-party startup delay to keep LCP below 2.5 s on mobile.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache inefficiencies delay initial content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,420 ms render-blocking savings and 126 KiB cache-lifetime savings; HAR identifies a VeryHigh-priority stylesheet and parser-inserted scripts, including AgeGO.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, confirm async/defer attributes, and set durable cache headers for versioned assets.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 119 KiB unused JavaScript, 19 KiB unused CSS and 54 KiB legacy JavaScript on the homepage; the detail estimate rises to 317 KiB unused JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific bundles, remove unused/legacy paths, and load ad/player dependencies only when needed.

findings.summary: Search and icon-only controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: The probe found an unlabelled required search input and an empty-value submit control; Lighthouse failed button-name and link-name on both audited templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible or programmatic labels and discernible names for every search, icon button and link.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit on both homepage and detail templates; screenshots show pale pink text on white and white text on bright pink.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast in every state.

findings.summary: Landmarks are incomplete and keyboard focus is not visible.
findings.evidence: Homepage probe found only aside and nav landmarks, no main; detail found aside and header, and focused links computed with no outline or shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic main/nav/header/footer landmarks, preserve a logical heading order, and implement :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Scaled mobile typography is too small to read comfortably.
findings.evidence: The 360 px capture renders the 980 px desktop canvas at 0.367 scale, shrinking card titles and metadata far below comfortable reading size.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive typography and grid reflow so body text remains readable without pinch zoom.

findings.summary: The page fails mobile reflow/target sizing and the primary video has no caption track.
findings.evidence: No viewport meta is present, Lighthouse fails target-size, and detail probe reports trackCount=0 for the primary video.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow normal zoom, reflow at narrow widths, enlarge targets, and provide captions/transcript for meaningful video content.

findings.summary: The video-detail template logs browser console errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s errors-in-console audit failed on the representative video-detail page.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the underlying player/ad integration errors and keep expected third-party failures contained.

findings.summary: The detail page raises DevTools inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s inspector-issues audit failed on the detail template, alongside third-party-cookie warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Review and eliminate DevTools Issues panel entries, updating third-party integrations where needed.

findings.summary: Indexable pages omit the viewport meta tag.
findings.evidence: DOM and layout probes show no meta viewport across homepage/detail, despite otherwise crawlable real href links and permissive robots.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and retain crawlable descriptive links.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack VideoObject structured data.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found accurate Open Graph fields but no JSON-LD, while the visible entity is a dated, duration-bearing video.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the title, description, thumbnail, duration and publication data.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used without baseline security headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found CSP, HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options all missing; it also found no frame or referrer policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff and secure cookie defaults, testing the player/ad allowlists explicitly.

findings.summary: The page contacts a broad advertising/analytics third-party set before interaction.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 7 third-party origins; HAR shows Matomo telemetry plus AgeGO and ad-provider scripts, with third-party script bytes dominating startup.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and transmitted fields, gate non-essential analytics/ads on consent, and load them only in context.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy in addition to missing HSTS/CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, strict referrer handling and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The age-gated player does not expose a robust runtime state.
findings.evidence: The repeated play interaction leaves the DOM/screenshot unchanged and presents no visible error, loading, verification or retry state.
findings.suggestedFix: Model verification/player states explicitly and make all failure paths visible, focus-managed and retryable.

findings.summary: Spanish pages are declared as British English.
findings.evidence: Both probes report html lang=en-GB while titles, navigation and body copy are Spanish; CSS inspection found no logical-property signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=es on Spanish pages, keep hreflang mappings accurate, and migrate layout-critical physical properties to logical equivalents.

findings.summary: Listing images lack responsive modern delivery.
findings.evidence: Images evidence reports 16/16 without srcset and four loaded thumbnails in legacy JPEG, with no modern-format images detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and preserve explicit dimensions/lazy behavior.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts consume a disproportionate share of the detail load.
findings.evidence: Detail HAR transfers 543,708 bytes of script out of 747,166 bytes total across 11 scripts, while ads and analytics are present before the user’s core video succeeds.
findings.suggestedFix: Budget third-party bytes, defer player advertising until playback intent, and remove vendors that do not justify their cost.

taskList.title: Deliver a real responsive mobile layout and readable/tappable controls
Repair and explain the age-verification/playback state machine
Add baseline security headers and minimise third-party data exposure
Fix accessible names, landmarks, focus and contrast
Defer, split and cache scripts/resources; constrain ad cost
Correct page language and enrich video metadata
Reduce chrome and add user-preference/navigation polish
Resolve console and DevTools integration issues
